businesses.business: Distributed power generation equipment and services

offering_description.value: The company manufactures low-emission microturbine systems for businesses and public facilities that need on-site power or combined heat and power. It sells and rents these systems and provides maintenance through its service and distributor network.

primary_products.value: Microturbine generators; packaged combined heat and power systems; replacement parts

primary_services.value: Equipment rental; contracted maintenance and repair; microgrid integration support

customer_segment.value: B2B: Industrial plants, oil and gas operators, commercial property owners, hospitals and project developers; B2G: Municipal wastewater utilities and public facility operators

end_markets.value: Industrial manufacturing; oil and gas; commercial buildings; healthcare; wastewater and landfill biogas

revenue_model.value: product sales: Microturbine systems, heat recovery packages and replacement parts; service fees: Maintenance agreements, field service and repairs; rental or leasing: Microturbine systems supplied under equipment rental agreements
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds packaged microturbine generators from turbine and electrical components for distributors and site operators; service provider: Maintains and repairs installed microturbine systems for site operators; asset operator: Owns and maintains a fleet of microturbine systems deployed at customer sites
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Microturbine power systems, heat recovery packages, equipment rentals and aftermarket services

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent distributors that sell and service microturbine systems in their territories; direct sales: Equipment rental and service agreements with site operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: On-site generation is subject to air emissions, electrical safety and utility interconnection requirements.

notes: The current scope of standalone battery storage and turnkey microgrid offerings is uncertain.
